author: EDM115 <npmjs@edm115.dev> (https://edm115.dev)
description: A CLI tool to generate hashes for the workspaces of your monorepo
name: monorepo-hash

scripts.build: pnpm build:node && pnpm build:bun && pnpm build:go
scripts.build:bun: pnpm cli:build-bin -r bun -p all && pnpm build:bun:chmod
scripts.build:bun:chmod: node -e "const { chmodSync } = require('fs'); const { readdirSync } = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const dir = path.join(__dirname, 'bun-build'); for (const file of readdirSync(dir)) { if (!file.includes('.')) { chmodSync(path.join(dir, file), 0o755); } }"
scripts.build:go: pnpm cli:build-bin -r go -p all && pnpm build:go:chmod
scripts.build:go:chmod: node -e "const { chmodSync, existsSync, readdirSync } = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const dir = path.join(__dirname, 'go-build'); if (existsSync(dir)) { for (const file of readdirSync(dir)) { if (!file.includes('.exe')) { chmodSync(path.join(dir, file), 0o755); } } }"
scripts.lint:go: cd src/go && GOEXPERIMENT=jsonv2 go vet ./... && GOEXPERIMENT=jsonv2 go tool staticcheck ./...
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const installBinaryPath = path.join(__dirname, 'dist', 'install-binary.mjs'); const srcPath = path.join(__dirname, 'src'); if (fs.existsSync(installBinaryPath) && !fs.existsSync(srcPath)) { const child_process = require('child_process'); child_process.execFileSync(process.execPath, [installBinaryPath], { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
scripts.test: pnpm test:node && pnpm test:bun && pnpm test:go
